name: Hayase Yuuno
source:
Real name: [spoiler]早瀬 憂乃 Hayase Yuuno[/spoiler]
Likes: shaved ice, Ramune, panda-themed goods
Skills: cooking, general housework
Role: assistant part-timer

[url=/c62607]Hayase Asano[/url]'s younger sister and a current high school girl. She works as a part-timer at Judgement 7 and is a "super assistant" who is capable of offering support in every task. Usually she is a carefree airhead, but should the need arise, her discernment, ability to take action and insightfulness surpass that of other members.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/yuno.html]the official site[/url]]
